description:
Return the jurisdiction_coverage state-machine status for one state
    (abbreviation or name), or the full stored coverage matrix if
    state is omitted. Public-registry and unlisted row counts are explicit. Includes bounded retained official-source observation health
    and evidence links. Coverage status measures stored bill/text availability;
    local coverage timestamps can advance on count recomputation. Statewide
    semantic freshness remains unverified, including for GREEN coverage.
name: get_jurisdiction_coverage
